ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which organelle is composed of RNA and protein?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a cell-organelle diagram of an animal cell. It shows internal structures such as a nucleus, mitochondria, folded membrane systems, and many tiny dot-like particles scattered in the cytoplasm and also attached to folded membranes; these dots are the usual representation of ribosomes. Reasoning: The question asks which organelle is composed of RNA and protein. In biology, ribosomes are ribonucleoprotein particles made of ribosomal RNA and proteins. Therefore, the organelle is the ribosome.
